summary: Iteration 90 - Testing 3 user-reported fixes: PDF filename prefill, thousand separators in PDF amounts, and BOM page print button visibility. All fixes verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (225 active BOMs, 31 quotations, 52 POs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three fixes verified: (1) PDF filename prefill via doc.title in pdfPrint.js, (2) Thousand separators via fmtAmt/fmtAmtForCurrency in numberFormat.js, (3) BOM print buttons visible immediately without waiting for explosions via skipExplosions:true and ensureExplosion lazy loading.

frontend.description: BOM page with 225 active BOMs loads in ~2.8 seconds. All 222 print buttons visible immediately without waiting for /explode API calls.
Print buttons (data-testid='print-bom-*') appear RIGHT AWAY for every BOM panel. Previously gated on explosion data, now always visible.
Clicking print button on unexpanded BOM triggers ensureExplosion() to lazy-fetch explosion data, then opens print dialog. No errors.
Quotation amounts display with Indian-style thousand separators: ₹1,003, ₹1,062, ₹10,620, ₹94,325. Summary cards also formatted correctly.
PO amounts display with thousand separators: ₹1,000.00, ₹1,180.00. PO print dialog shows formatted amounts.
pdfPrint.js sets doc.title = titleNoExt (line 154) which browsers use for 'Save as PDF' filename. Filenames follow pattern: Quotation-QUO000043.pdf, PO-PO000039.pdf, BOM-FG-001.pdf
PO print dialog opens correctly with template options (Standard, Detailed GST, Compact, Modern), paper size, and display options.

filename_prefill.implementation: pdfPrint.js line 153-154: doc.title = titleNoExt (removes .pdf extension). Browser uses document title for Save as PDF filename.

thousand_separators.implementation: numberFormat.js exports fmtAmt (Indian locale en-IN) and fmtAmtForCurrency (en-IN for INR, en-US for USD/EUR). Used in CRMPage.js, PrintDialogs.js, BOMPage.js, ManufacturingPage.js, JobWorkPage.js

bom_print_button_visibility.implementation: BOMPage.js: fetchBoms({skipExplosions:true}) on initial load. Print button always visible (gated on activeBom, not explosion). ensureExplosion(bomId) lazy-fetches on print click or panel expand.
bom_print_button_visibility.performance: 222 print buttons visible in 2.8 seconds (previously waited for 225+ /explode calls)

code_review.pdfPrint.js: Clean implementation. Sets iframe.title and doc.title for filename prefill. A4 width (794px) for proper print layout.
code_review.numberFormat.js: Proper use of Intl.NumberFormat with en-IN locale for Indian grouping (1,23,456.78) and en-US for Western grouping.
code_review.BOMPage.js: Good lazy loading pattern with ensureExplosion(). Print button visibility no longer blocked by explosion data loading.
